Kojonup farmer Liz Heggaton said the sale was "a perfect opportunity to get people talking". (ABC Great Southern: Andrew Chounding)

Kojonup farmer Liz Heggaton has donated a Kojak ram, a self-shedding breed, to prostate cancer awareness at her annual ram sale.

Her husband Craig died by suicide in 2024 while being treated for the disease, and she lost her son James in a car accident this year.

After a devastating two years, Liz Heggaton is continuing to urge men to "start speaking and start testing" for prostate cancer.

Despite losing her husband and son in tragic circumstances in the space of two years, Liz Heggaton says she still has plenty to get out of bed for each morning.
